channel.title: joão carabetta — public work
channel.description: physicist by training; builds public data infrastructure in Brazil — open datasets, city platforms, and the tools between them.

item.title: Onde o Brasil mora — race and income, Census 2022
item.description: a national dot-density map from the 2022 census — switch race and household income; one point per N units, on settlements at country scale and census tracts up close.

item.title: Bloomberg Mayors Challenge — winner
item.description: rio among 24 global winners for iplanrio's proactive AI / digital active-outreach model against multidimensional vulnerability — US$1M to scale connecting families to health, school, and social services.

item.title: CompStat Rio — field app + datalake
item.description: iplanrio built the internal geodata app that feeds CompStat Rio — NYPD-style crime-factor mapping into the municipal datalake for mayor-led security reviews.

item.title: Rio AI City — partnership with X (Alphabet)
item.description: signed with X – The Moonshot Factory: connectivity (Taara), grid AI (Tapestry), licensing (Anori), and recycling (Materra) — iplanrio led the technical articulation.

item.title: Pequenos Cariocas — data + eligibility stack
item.description: iplanrio integrated SMAS systems with CadÚnico, automated WhatsApp outreach, and Carioca Digital checks for the early-childhood protection network and PIC card.

item.title: Histórico Clínico Integrado — SMS Rio
item.description: one clinical history for ~7M patients across primary care and emergency — built on the health data lake SMS ran with iplanrio / the data office.

item.title: Nature Scientific Data — Rio bus mobility dataset
item.description: equal-contribution paper with Carvalho, Vancellote, Casais & others — open dataset of bus GPS and environmental indicators from Rio.

item.title: FGV EMAp — mathematics in cities
item.description: talk on how Rio uses terabytes of data to solve real problems — as CTO and president of iplanrio.

item.title: op-ed in O Dia
item.description: on data that transform cities — and why public technology earns trust when it becomes invisible plumbing.

item.title: Google Cloud global case — Escritório de Dados
item.description: Rio's data office featured among Google Cloud's public-sector references for integrating 20+ secretariats and 4.7B+ records.

item.title: Mulher.Rio
item.description: anonymous platform for women facing violence — Secretaria da Mulher with CIVITAS and iplanrio on the tech. later pushed via Taxi.Rio in Agosto Lilás.

item.title: CTO of Rio · president of iplanrio
item.description: led Rio's municipal technology company — 1746, carioca digital, processo.rio, health systems — after years as chief data officer.

item.title: G20 em Dados — especial
item.description: we published an interactive special on what hosting the G20 meant for Rio — money, people, and the city's global stage.

item.title: Govtech 4 Impact World Congress
item.description: spoke as Rio's chief data officer on civic tech, open data, and city-scale infrastructure.

item.title: Destino: Rio de Janeiro — megaevents
item.description: we mapped why the city spends public money hosting the world — not just for the photo op.

item.title: Estamos de olho! — CIVITAS dataviz
item.description: a public storytelling piece on how the intelligence center watches the city 24/7 — cameras, radars, and the pipes behind public safety.

item.title: CIVITAS — Rio intelligence center
item.description: city intelligence hub for public safety — cameras, radars, 1746, and the municipal datalake. iplanrio / the data office fed the pipes; google later cited 6M+ plate reads/day.

item.title: O Rio nunca teve tanta gente trabalhando
item.description: we told the jobs recovery through three cariocas who found work — and the numbers behind the rebound.

item.title: chapter — Governança de dados no setor público (UNU)
item.description: co-authored chapter in the UNU ebook on public-sector data governance — wrote as Rio's chief data officer and Base dos Dados co-founder.

item.title: obras & CEP — where the city invests
item.description: two especiais: infrastructure prioritized for the North and West Zones, and CEP — the street-level program against violence.
